title: What the Raven knows

is_this_you.pressure: You go quiet. Then you move your plans somewhere nobody watched you put them.
is_this_you.love: A long, private test comes first. Pass it, and you get a partner for life who defends your corner with you.
is_this_you.cost: You remember who cheated you long after they forget the trade. Being right about people gets lonely.

opener.text: Odin kept two ravens. Huginn means thought. Muninn is usually read as memory [s6]. Each day they flew the world and came back to whisper what they saw [s6]. Odin feared for Thought, and more for Memory [s6]. You were born with both birds.

howto: Four parts, one bird. Start anywhere.

rows.text: Aquarius is fixed Air, ruled by Uranus and, in the older books, by Saturn [s1]. The sign is inventive and at ease being different [s1]. The Monkey adds yang Metal [s2]. Witty and quick to learn [s3]. So you stand at the edge of the group and see how it fits. Then you do the clever thing nobody saw coming.

Ravens plan. In a 2017 study they chose a tool or a token and saved it for later use [s14]. Ravens also play, and Heinrich and Smolker reported them sliding down snowy roofs on their backs [s20]. Same bird. Same mind. You can plan ten moves out and still want the roof.

A raven that sees a rival watching will cache its food farther off, or wait [s17]. It also treats a rival who saw the hiding differently from one who missed it [s16]. You keep a second place for what matters. Few people know where it is.
In a 2017 study, ravens still chose a fair trader over a cheat a month later [s22] [s23]. Your file on who played you is short. It is accurate. You open it far less often than they fear.

tabs.label: Who you trust
tabs.intro: The few you let watch you cache.
tabs.love_lead: Love comes late, then stays. The Monkey is slow to settle and fully committed once it chooses [s3]. Ravens pair for life [s13]. You test someone for a long time and never call it a test. Pass, and you have them.

tabs.label: Where your mind earns
tabs.intro: Get paid for the long memory.

rows.text: Work that pays you to read many players at once suits you. Strategy and forecasting fit. So does fraud work, where a long memory is the job. Directing sits on the old Monkey career list too [s3]. Puzzle and game design count, if you like building the trap.

easy.why: The Meerkat (Gemini, Rat year) shares the Monkey's trine of Rat, Dragon and Monkey, and Gemini is Air like you [s4] [s1].
The Giant Manta Ray (Libra, Dragon year) closes your trine, and Libra makes the third Air sign beside you [s4] [s1].
The Cuttlefish (Gemini, Snake year) is your secret friend, since Snake and Monkey form a Six Harmonies pair [s4].

hard.why: The hard one is the Harpy Eagle, because Tiger clashes with Monkey and Leo stands opposite Aquarius [s4] [s1].

story.text: The Greeks said the raven was white until it told Apollo of Coronis's betrayal too fast [s9]. He turned it black for its chattering tongue [s9].

closing: You still tell the truth. You just check who is watching first.
